questions.question: What is the new activity in the zoo in November?

analyses.content: 录音提到因为处于11月，动物园在晚上7点后提供两小时的迷你旅行（mini tour），这就对应了选项A的晚间游览。
你可能听到篝火晚会（bonfire nights）和派对（parties）想选B或C，但录音明确说篝火晚会已经取消了，而派对是在下个月的圣诞节，并不是11月的新活动。

As you know, it's November now, and that means longer days. I have some good news for you. Anyone who hates getting up early in the morning can now enter the zoo after dinner. Because of the time of year, we are offering a two-hour mini tour after seven PM. Seeing the animals at a different time of day will be a fascinating experience for many of you, and I encourage you to sign up. Unfortunately, due to a fire last month, we no longer allow bonfire nights. By the way, we have been planning two parties for Christmas next month. We'll post the details on our website. It should be a lot of fun.

questions.question: What is the most popular species in the zoo?

analyses.content: 录音明确指出动物园毫无疑问的“明星动物”（star animal）是考拉（koala），对应选项B。
你可能一听到袋鼠（kangaroo）或牧羊犬（sheepdog）就想选，但录音用“not”直接否定了这两个选项，读题和听音时要格外留意否定词。

So let me tell you a little about our residents here at the zoo. Despite what was recently reported in the media, the most popular animal around here is not the kangaroo or even the sheepdog. No, our star animal here is without doubt the koala. They are sedentary creatures and can sleep for up to twenty hours a day, so you'll have to keep an eye out for them. You should be able to spot some of them in the treetops hiding behind branches. But if you're lucky, you might see one run across your path.

questions.question: What is the key to feeding kangaroos?

analyses.content: 录音强调给袋鼠喂食时，保持直立的姿势（upright posture）很重要，对应选项C的站直身体。
你可能会听到baby或者another one想选B或A，但录音明确交代了绝对不要和袋鼠宝宝有身体接触（avoided），且换一只喂的前提是当前这只吃饱了，而不是同时喂多只。

Of course, we do have kangaroos. They are truly fascinating creatures. It might interest you to know that they are the only large animals that use hopping as a means of locomotion. They are generally very friendly, and while we have no problems with people feeding them, we always tell our guests that it's important to stand with an upright posture when giving them food. The kangaroos may interpret you bending over as a sign of aggression, so please be careful. Also, no matter how cute the babies are, any physical contact should be avoided. The adults are quite protective of their young while they are still in the pouch, so please refrain from the urge to give them a pat. They aren't greedy animals and will generally stop eating once they are full. So if you have some extra food, you might need to find another one to feed.

questions.question: Why is the wild dog area closed?

analyses.content: 录音明确提到目前正在修理围栏（fixing the fences），对应选项B的区域正在维修（under repair）。
你可能听到健康（health）相关词汇想选A，但录音是在强调野狗们身体很健康（in good health），直接排除了生病不舒服的可能。

As you may have heard, our wild dog pen is temporarily closed, but it should reopen soon. You'll be happy to know that our dogs are all fine and in good health, and I think they are quite excited about their new home. Right now, we are fixing the fences. They are wild animals after all, and we need to consider public safety before opening the exhibit. But please come back to see them when we are finished.

questions.question: Where can visitors get discount tickets this year?

analyses.content: 录音说明今年的打折券只能在礼品店附近的咖啡馆（cafe）获得，对应选项A。
你可能听到官网（website）或礼品店（gift shop）的字眼就急着选B或C，但录音说官网正在维护，而礼品店只是用来提示咖啡馆位置的参照物。

Speaking of return visits, if you enjoy our zoo and want to come back, you may be interested in getting a discount ticket. We used to sell them at the entrance of the zoo as well as on our website, but the website is currently under maintenance, so the coupons are available only at the cafe near the gift shop for this year. So if you're interested, make your way over there once you are ready. Be informed there are a lot of tourists around today, so the earlier the better.
录音给出的行进路线是从入口（entrance）出发，过桥（cross the bridge）后一直走到路尽头，竞技场就在你的右边（right）。
地图题最容易跟丢，你需要听准起点是入口，并牢牢抓住“过桥”和“路尽头右转”这两个绝对不可错过的关键动作。

Now, if I can bring your attention to the map of our zoo, I'll provide a brief description of the grounds so that no one gets lost. If you'd like to see some of our animals up close, then you should visit one of our shows in the arena. We have a show every half hour, so you're sure to see something. We are at the entrance. To get there, cross the bridge and go straight to the end of the path, and you'll find it to your right.
录音说明教育大厅在动物园的北部（north），并且紧挨着厕所的西边（west of the toilets）。
如果你没有听清方向词，很容易选错位置，务必抓准方位核心词“北边”和明确的参照物“厕所”。

For those who are looking for a quieter place to learn about the history of our zoo, in the north of the zoo, we have an educational hall ready for you. It's easy to find, just to the west of the toilets.
野餐地点在植物园周围（surrounding the botanic garden），并且面向河流（facing the river）。
听到野餐不要急着找空地，必须把“植物园”和“面向河”这两个关键参照物结合起来才能做最终确认。

With such beautiful weather right now, I know many of you would love to spend the afternoon having a picnic. There is a great spot for you in the zoo. It's the area surrounding the botanic garden, and it's also facing the river. The view is fantastic there.
照片打印店现在已经搬到了桥旁边的建筑里（next to the bridge）。
你可能一听到东北角（northeastern corner）就立刻找对应字母，但这只是用来混淆你的旧地址，录音随后用“moved to”引出了真正的新位置。
Some of you may recall that our photo printing site was in the northeastern corner of the zoo. It has now been moved to the building next to the bridge.
录音明确指出，出口（exit）就在礼品店的旁边（beside it）。
这段录音前面铺垫了很长的自行车内容，容易让你走神，实际上真正的定位关键点全在最后一句话里的参照物“出口”上。

Finally, I'm sure you've noticed that it's quite warm today. If you're not up for walking, don't worry. We have bike sheds at different locations across the zoo, and the bikes are free for our guests. So just grab one and take it for a ride. Once you've got your bike, it's only a five-minute ride to the gift shop, and the exit is just beside it. You can't miss it. Please note that cycling is only permitted on the designated paths.
